note: B25R1-016 section 12: targeted scenarios for rare features that may not occur organically in the 365-day campaign. Each starts from a fresh world of its seed with the documented start below, applies the listed steps through the systems' own scenario entry points (LifeDecisions.set_hardship / weigh_runaway / recruit / leave_band, Homesteads.begin / set_faction: they set a record or run a decision exactly as the dawn would; no rule, weight or probability is changed), then runs the normal game for its days with the flight recorder on. A scenario proves a mechanic can work; it says nothing of its natural frequency. Run: godot --headless --path game --script res://tests/flight_scenarios.gd -- --out DIR. Read by tools/flight_lives.py --targeted DIR, reported apart from the organic campaign.

scenarios.name: young_adult_homestead
scenarios.start: seed 1 village; unpartnered adults under 25 who hold no post, in order of household then id: the first whom the game's own homestead gates (Homesteads.gate) let go and who finds a site and the coins sets out as a young adult; each refusal is listed

scenarios.name: established_adult_homestead
scenarios.start: seed 2 village; partnered adults aged 25 or over who hold no post, in the same order: the first couple the gates let go and who find a site and the coins set out as established adults

scenarios.name: outlaw_homestead
scenarios.start: seed 3 village; a young adult sets out (as young_adult_homestead); once the claim exists it is turned outlaw and concealed

scenarios.name: youth_runaway
scenarios.start: seed 1 village; the first household with a member aged 12-16 is given 12 dawns of hardship and a major event today; that youngest member weighs running

scenarios.name: recruit_runaway
scenarios.start: as youth_runaway, then the youth asks the band to join

scenarios.name: recruit_displaced_adult
scenarios.start: seed 2 village; the first household's poorest unpartnered adult (no post) is given 12 dawns of household hardship and asks the band to join

scenarios.name: recruit_orphan
scenarios.start: seed 3 village; the first child under 12 with both parents alive loses both (World.kill, cause scenario); the orphan rules (FAM-07) place them; if unplaced, the child asks the band

scenarios.name: bandit_departure
scenarios.start: seed 1 village; the first living adult bandit leaves the band through LifeDecisions.leave_band
